subject: Assigning invoice creator and daily batch-cutoff for consolidated remits
messages:
From: Joanna Smyth <joanna@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice generation ownership for consolidated remit

Hi Karthik —

Quick question from our AP team as we prep for next month: we have two legal entities in scope for Redwood billing and want to confirm who will be the invoice *creator/sender* for consolidated remits, and what the daily batch cutoff would be for invoice generation.

Specifically:
- Do you send a single consolidated PDF with line-item splits by entity (and include per-entity VAT evidence), or will you send separate invoices per legal entity?
- What timestamp is the cutoff for the daily run so our systems know when to expect invoices each day?

We need this to map PO numbers and to schedule bank reconciliation. Can you confirm by EOW?

Thanks,
Joanna
Joanna Smyth
Head of AP, Acme Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Joanna Smyth <joanna@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice generation ownership for consolidated remit

Hi Joanna — thanks for the clear ask. We can support either approach but want to be explicit on pros/cons so your AP team can pick a deterministic flow: 

Options:
1) Redwood as invoice creator/sender (recommended) — Redwood issues a consolidated PDF each day with a top-level summary and individual per-entity pages. VAT evidence (PDF) is attached per entity. Sender: billing@redwood-inference.com
2) Per-entity invoices — we produce separate PDFs per legal entity and deliver them separately (useful if you require separate invoice numbers per ledger).

Batch-cutoff options (what we run as the daily job):
- Recommended: 17:30 UTC (gives us time to reconcile before overnight batch processing).
- Alternative: 18:00 UTC if you need a slightly later window.

If you approve option 1 we will:
- Send consolidated PDF + individual VAT evidence attachments via your chosen channel (SFTP push or email).
- Include PO-number mapping in the invoice metadata if you provide PO mapping rules.

I've attached a short sample PDF and SFTP instructions for the push workflow. Marissa, Grace — can you confirm the payload fields (invoice number format, entity tag, VAT attachment envelope) and whether 17:30 UTC is feasible on the infra side?

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
billing@redwood-inference.com

Attachment: invoice_sample_consolidated.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-05T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice generation ownership for consolidated remit

Karthik —

Quick technical notes from engineering/finance integration:
- Payload: We can include a single envelope JSON that references the consolidated PDF and then an array of per-entity attachments (base64 refs or Drive links).
- Invoice number format: rdw-YYYYMMDD-<seq> (this keeps numbers unique across consolidated batches).
- Batch job runtime: 17:30 UTC is safe, but for AP systems that pull from SFTP overnight I recommend finalizing by 17:00 UTC so clients have the file before their EOD processes start (some clients are in US/EU).

VAT handling: we will include a small VAT-evidence bundle per entity (pdf) and a CSV manifest that maps invoice pages to entity VAT IDs. If Acme needs reverse-charge marking, we can add a per-line flag in the CSV.

Attached is the SFTP push template and a sample manifest.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Billing Integrations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: SFTP_integration_instructions.txt

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-07T14:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice generation ownership for consolidated remit

Joanna / Karthik —

Two compliance points to confirm before we finalize:
1) If Acme requires VAT evidence embedded in the invoice stream for EU entities (reverse charge), we should deliver a separate PDF per entity with a clear header and VAT ID. A consolidated PDF is fine as long as each entity's pages are clearly demarcated and a CSV manifest exists.
2) Data residency: for SFTP pushes, confirm whether you need files hosted in EU region storage or US. We have region-mapped endpoints but need the preference by Tuesday to configure.

Lastly: PO handling — do you want PO numbers printed on the invoice top header or included only in the CSV manifest? Some AP systems prefer the header (easier human processing), others rely only on machine mapping.

If you can confirm: VAT evidence per entity: yes/no; region preference: US/EU; PO display: header/manifest — we will lock the workflow.

Thanks,
Grace
Director, Finance Integrations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Final: Redwood as invoice sender + 17:30 UTC daily cutoff (action items)

Hi Joanna / Acme AP —

Thanks for the back-and-forth. Per our internal review and your requirements, Redwood will act as the invoice creator/sender for the consolidated remit. Final decisions below:

- Sender: billing@redwood-inference.com (please whitelist)
- Delivery channel: SFTP push (we can dual-deliver email copies on request)
- Batch cutoff: 17:30 UTC daily — files delivered within 30 minutes of job completion
- Payload: Consolidated PDF (top-level summary + per-entity pages) + per-entity VAT evidence PDFs + CSV manifest mapping pages->entity->VAT ID->PO
- Invoice numbering: rdw-YYYYMMDD-<seq> (sequence restarts daily)
- Region: US storage for pushes (change on request)

Next steps for Acme AP:
1) Confirm PO mapping rules (header vs manifest) — reply to this thread.
2) Whitelist billing@redwood-inference.com and add our SFTP host to allowlist (details in attached SFTP_integration_instructions.txt).
3) Confirm if you want email copies (yes/no).

We attached: invoice_sample_consolidated.pdf and SFTP_integration_instructions.txt. If you sign off we will schedule a one-hour handoff call next week to validate a test run.

Please reply with sign-off or any redlines by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Karthik
